asr.full_text: Hello and welcome to another update video on AVAX. I'm tracking here the decline on the AVAX chart as an A, B, C structure. The chart is in a strong downtrend. We've broken below 2023 lows, 2022 lows. There is just no clear upside reversal. There is also no clear downside impulse, but I am tracking the move down from the March 2024 high as a diagonal structure to the downside in which we are working on the third wave. Probably the late stages of the third wave, then we could get a wave 4 bounce and a wave 5 down. This wave 4 bounce could be imminent, I don't see any evidence really at started but if bitcoin starts to move up then Avex could follow and reach 1366 to 1977 in that process. Now can we add some further support levels, the only way at the moment for me to add, well few ways actually to add support, the immediate one is this one, where we're tracking the length of the wave1 I go to the high of the wave two ... and we can see that the next support level is at 650. That's the 161.8 Fibonacci extension. When we apply that live here, this is the next level. An ideal target for a third wave. We don't have to get there, because the third wave is already long enough so we donít have to get there yet. Another way to use Fibonacci extension on Trading-View is to measure the length of the a-wave. We go the high of the b-wave which is the 2024 high. And then the 100% extension will be relevant as ideal target for this c wave here but you see that this is a target for the c wave so we in in the internal third wave the next level above is relevant so eight dollars and 28 which is exactly where we found support right now so that might be the explanation why the market is currently holding there. The 78.6% extension at $8.28 is not a particularly strong support level, but it is still one that is worth watching and which clearly now led to a small tiny bounce early February. So that means if we get a rally I I will treat it as corrective in nature and it should be a three-wave move-up that can reach the resistance area. Only a five-wave move-up that breaks above $19.77, let's call it $20, would suggest that something more bullish is playing out. But please note that the yellow scenario which I've got here, in which we're tracking a larger B wave as a flat correction, in which this yellow B wave overshoots to the downside, It's a very questionable scenario, which I've got here. Where we are tracking a larger b-wave as a flat correction, in which this yellow b-wave overshoots to the downside. This is very questionable and speculative, but I need a bullish alternative. That's the count I have from a bullish point of view, but the yellow scenario is currently not the most probable one. The blue scenario appears to be leading. So that's the update on the AVEX , hope you like the update. If you did please hit the like button leave a comment and subscribe and if you're interested in additional updates then check out our Axe channel. I leave a link in the comment section for you. On Axe you get a lot of additional, updates, exclusive video updates and much more. Thanks so much. I Wish you a great day bye-bye.
